text: For n <= 1 the function should still end in a defined way (for example raise an exception); only the returned value is left free.
The assumption is only a promise about typical inputs: a prime n still has a well-defined smallest and largest prime factor (n itself), so for a prime n the function must still return n.

phrase: the smallest or largest prime factor
text: The implementation picks one convention and keeps it: either every call returns the smallest prime factor, or every call returns the largest.
